intro.title: Human capacity built alongside commercial craft.
intro.lede: Beyond client engagements, KR8 DIGITALS operates four structured ecosystem initiatives: 100% tuition-free training, an active creative community, a mindset & leadership forum, and a merit-based pathway onto our studio delivery team.
intro.imageAlt: Learners collaborating inside the KR8 DIGITALS free training ecosystem

programmes.name: Free Digital Skills & Academic Training
programmes.imageAlt: KR8 Academy practical digital skills cohort
programmes.lede: Two structured learning doors — market-ready digital crafts through KR8 Academy, and STEM/Arts exam excellence through Next Gen Scholars. Zero tuition.
programmes.body: Talent is evenly distributed, but access to practical mentorship rarely is. Our flagship training opens two complementary doors at zero tuition cost: KR8 Academy teaches seven hands-on digital tracks led by working practitioners — including Graphic Design with Steveoking (Motionverse) and Video Editing with Creative Expression (Chigoma) — while Next Gen Scholars prepares secondary and pre-university learners for WAEC and JAMB across Sciences and Arts.
programmes.commitment: Structured weekly cohorts · Practical assignments & portfolio reviews

doors.name: Digital Skills Door · KR8 Academy
doors.line: Seven practical creative and technical tracks: Website Development, Front-End Engineering, Graphic Design, Video Editing, Content Creation, Social Media Management, and Digital Marketing.
doors.partner: Led by KR8 DIGITALS with Motionverse & Chigoma

doors.name: Academic Door · Next Gen Scholars
doors.line: Structured Sciences and Arts instruction preparing ambitious students for WAEC and JAMB excellence alongside digital literacy.
doors.partner: Delivered with Academic Partner Next Gen Scholars

programmes.name: KR8 DIGITALS TRIBE
programmes.imageAlt: Designers, developers, and editors collaborating inside KR8 DIGITALS TRIBE
programmes.lede: The creative family where designers, developers, video editors, and founders sharpen their craft long after a training cohort ends.
programmes.body: Most learners stall in isolation the moment a course finishes — with nobody to critique work-in-progress, share overflow opportunities, or hold standards high. KR8 DIGITALS TRIBE keeps the studio room open: honest work reviews, interdisciplinary sprints, peer accountability, and shared creative growth.
programmes.commitment: Ongoing peer critique · Collaborative challenges · Shared growth

programmes.name: Mindset Shift
programmes.statusLabel: Interest List Open · Editions Announced When Confirmed
programmes.imageAlt: Mindset Shift conversation and gathering hosted by KR8 DIGITALS
programmes.lede: Candid conversations designed to reframe how ambitious young people think about craft, value creation, career longevity, and leadership.
programmes.body: Technical skill alone does not build a career if limiting beliefs hold a builder back. Convened by Timfire and guest practitioners who have built real enterprises and careers, Mindset Shift brings learners, creatives, and founders together to examine discipline, ethical wealth creation, execution habits, and long-term vision.
programmes.commitment: Curated editions · Speaker announcements sent directly to registered list
programmes.editionsNote: Upcoming edition dates and guest speakers are published only once formally confirmed. Join the interest list to receive direct invitations first.

programmes.name: Join the Team
programmes.imageAlt: Web engineers, brand designers, and video editors reviewing creative portfolios inside the KR8 DIGITALS studio
programmes.lede: The merit-based bridge from mastering your craft to shipping live commercial projects alongside the KR8 DIGITALS studio team.
programmes.body: KR8 DIGITALS grows from the inside out. Exceptional builders — whether trained through KR8 Academy or proven independently in web engineering, brand design, graphic design, video editing, SEO, or AI workflows — can submit real work for studio review and collaborate on commercial client deliveries.
programmes.commitment: Merit-based portfolio review · Practical trial collaboration · Client-grade standards

principles.d: Every track and mentorship session is led by builders actively shipping commercial web, brand, design, and film work.
Flagship digital skills and academic preparation remain 100% tuition-free so raw discipline and talent decide how far you go.
We measure progress by shipped portfolios, working code, clean edits, and honest peer critique — never empty certificates.
